entries.wording: 运单创建成功，等待扣款处理
entries.english: Waybill created, waiting for the charge
entries.note: The first row, written when the customer books the parcel.

entries.wording: 运单扣款成功，等待出库
entries.english: Waybill charged, waiting to leave the warehouse
entries.note: The warehouse holds the parcel and has charged the shipment.

entries.wording: 包裹已出库，送往机场途中
entries.english: The parcel has left the warehouse for the airport
US customs, loaded on a flight
entries.note: Export from the US, before the flight to China.

entries.wording: 青岛市【青岛李沧站】，已揽收
entries.note: BEST Express's first row after clearance: the courier in China takes the parcel on.

entries.wording: 百世快递已揽件，快递单号：…
entries.english: Picked up by BEST Express, courier number …
entries.note: The platform's row for the hand-off to the courier in China, with that courier's number.

entries.wording: 到青岛市【青岛转运中心】
青岛市【青岛转运中心】，正发往【北京转运中心】
北京市【北京房山区窦店分部】，正在派件
entries.note: The row names the courier with a mobile in a bracket, which the reader leaves out.

entries.wording: 北京市【北京房山区窦店分部】，已签收
entries.note: The row names the person who signed, whom the reader leaves out.
